headline: Vikas Agrawal Extradited To India In Chhattisgarh Liquor Scam Case
seoTitle: Vikas Agrawal Extradited In Chhattisgarh Liquor Scam
metaDescription: Vikas Agrawal, a key accused in the Rs 1,280 crore Chhattisgarh liquor scam, has been extradited from the UAE following an Interpol Red Notice.
aiSummaryBullets: Vikas Agrawal was returned to India from the United Arab Emirates to face charges in a significant liquor distribution investigation.
The legal case involves alleged irregularities occurring in Chhattisgarh between 2019 and 2022.
Authorities acted following an Interpol Red Notice issued against the suspect for his alleged role in the syndicate.
aiContextParagraph: The extradition follows an investigation into a large-scale liquor scam in Chhattisgarh, which authorities estimate resulted in financial irregularities totaling Rs 1,280 crore. The alleged illicit activities took place between 2019 and 2022, a period coinciding with the state government led by the Congress party under former Chief Minister Bhupesh Baghel. The Enforcement Directorate and the Central Bureau of Investigation have been examining the operations of the syndicate, identifying the suspect as a central figure or 'moneyman' in the distribution scheme. Following the issuance of an Interpol Red Notice, international cooperation led to his apprehension in the United Arab Emirates. He was subsequently brought back to India to face ongoing criminal proceedings initiated by the Chhattisgarh police. This development marks a significant step in the long-running probe into the state's historical liquor distribution policies and financial management.
whyItIsViral: This story is trending due to reports from two independent national news outlets detailing a major high-profile extradition case.
